anomalies.observed: Keyboard column COL2 (U3 pin 9) and keyboard row ROW4 (U3 pin 20) both carry the net label NET0009. The same label also appears on the SKW92A top-edge pin label group on page 2. Row and column lines of the BBQ10KBD matrix therefore resolve to one node.
anomalies.expected: Each matrix row and column should be a separate net, joined only through the key switches. The spec describes 5 column lines and 7 row lines wired directly to separate SKW92A GPIO pins, so a column and a row should never share a net.

evidence.quote: BBQ10KBD ... 5 column + 7 row lines wired directly to SKW92A GPIO pins (matrix scanned by the module itself, not via an onboard keyboard controller)

anomalies.impact: Pressing keys would create shorts between a column and a row line. Matrix scanning would misread keys, and the GPIO drivers could fight each other.

parsed.summary: The power section, EPD driver values and barrel-jack wiring match the spec. The one concrete deviation I can read off the drawing is that keyboard column COL2 and row ROW4 share the same net label, NET0009, which would short a matrix row to a column; confidence is moderate because the label reading comes from a dense tile.
